Dress with a completely white appearance, the 27 -year -old reveals her fashion ultimatums that begin with one of the most controversial: adjusted jeans or wide legs?

Adjusted jeans or wide leg
“I know for me, I’m going to choose the baggy jeans of wide legs 10 of 10 times,” says the star.
Adding: “But thin jeans are returning.”
Helled jeans are attractive to younger generations due to their versatility.
Space pants can easily pass casual to elegant with correct accessories.
The thin jeans were the first popular in the 2000s and again in the 2010. Some say they are a medium age sign.
But as Sandy points out, they are having a resurgence of the track.
On recent catwalks, including Miu Miu, Balenciaga, Isabel Marant and Versace, the silhouette has been reintroduced with large matches.

Saved or luxury
“Ok, here is another ultimatum,” says Lana del Rey as a guy.
‘Thrifted or Luxury, what am I going to go? Now, I love a good savings finding, ‘admits.
“My shoes are currently saved, they are vintage, so I have to say vintage.”
Sandy is not alone with his preference.
While luxury products are very coveted, the savings option is a trend and environmental option for the environment.
When buying second -hand fashions, it keeps them out of the landfills and reduces the demand for a new clothing production.
In addition to being the mentality of nature, which allows you to find unique and distinctive pieces instead of buying mass market trends.
